name: amit
zh_summary: @amitisinvesting 回覆 @aleabitoreddit，表示不確定 $ASTS 的長期前景，但認為股價橫行數月甚至數年並不會推翻真正的投資邏輯；許多股票被困 2 至 3 年後才獲市場認可，$AMD 就是最近的例子。
en_summary: @amitisinvesting, replying to @aleabitoreddit, says he is unsure about $ASTS long term but that months or years of range-bound price action do not break a real thesis; many names were stuck for 2 to 3 years before the market recognized them, with $AMD the latest example.
text: Agreed. Not sure what happens to $ASTS long term but if price action within a range for several months, if not years, is what breaks a thesis, then there never was a thesis. Many of the names you mentioned were stuck for 2-3 years before the market recognized them. $AMD is the most recent example of that. Either you chase the new shiny thing or actually become an investor and believe in a thesis long enough to give it time to become real.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay：$TE在12月關稅前取得1.725 GW太陽能電池進口豁免，足以供應達拉斯工廠至G2於2027年第一季本土投產；G2首期僅覆蓋達拉斯一半產量。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $TE secured a 1.725 GW solar cell import waiver ahead of December tariffs, supplying its Dallas factory until G2 starts domestic production in Q1 2027; G2's first phase covers only half of Dallas output.
text:
$TE just secured a 1.725 GW solar cell import waiver ahead of December’s tariffs giving its Dallas factory enough supply until G2 begins domestic production in Q1 2027.

That puts T1 ahead of competitors facing higher import costs but with G2’s first phase only covering half of Dallas’s output so the real test is whether it can scale domestic production profitably.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示 $SOFI 推出 SOFIE，是首個由全國性銀行發行的消費者代幣化存款，利率 4.40% 並符合 FDIC 保險資格，認為 SoFi 的銀行牌照可吸引鏈上存款為放貸業務提供資金。附圖為 SoFi 標誌。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $SOFI launched SOFIE, the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers, paying 4.40% with FDIC insurance eligibility, and argues SoFi's bank charter lets it attract on-chain deposits to fund lending. The image is the SoFi logo.
text:
$SOFI just launched SOFIE which is the first national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers offering 4.40% interest with FDIC insurance eligibility.

That’s where SoFi’s bank charter becomes a real advantage because it can attract on-chain deposits that help fund its lending business while customers continue earning interest.

name: Business Breakdowns
zh_summary: （由 @patrick_oshag 轉發）@bizbreakdowns 與 Sandstone Global Investment 的 Fraser Christie 剖析 $AFRM，對方認為 Affirm 可成為互聯網的支付網絡。重點包括：股價在 2021 年上市後曾下跌逾 95%，目前處理逾 500 億美元 GMV 且增長逾 30%，佔美國先買後付約 50% 份額，交易額毛利約 4%，Affirm Card 約佔交易額 20% 且年增逾 100%。
en_summary: (Reposted by @patrick_oshag) @bizbreakdowns breaks down $AFRM with Fraser Christie of Sandstone Global Investment, who believes Affirm can become the payment network of the internet. Points include: the stock fell more than 95% after its 2021 IPO, it now processes over $50B in GMV growing more than 30%, holds about 50% of US buy now pay later, earns about 4% gross profit on volume, and Affirm Card is about 20% of volume growing over 100% a year.
text:
Today, we are breaking down @Affirm.
 
Affirm's stock fell more than 95% after its IPO in 2021. Today, it processes over $50 billion in GMV and is growing more than 30%, faster than when it was a fraction of its current size.

Its founder, Max Levchin (@mlevchin), grew up in Ukraine, moved to the US as a teenager, and co-founded PayPal in his early 20s. 

While in college, he funded his first startups with credit cards and unknowingly destroyed his credit score. Years later, even after PayPal's IPO, he was denied a car loan because of his credit history. 

That experience helped inspire Affirm's founding mission of building more honest financial products.

Fraser Christie, founder and CIO of Sandstone Global Investment, joined us to break down the business, its remarkable recovery, and why he believes Affirm can become the payment network of the internet.

Some interesting facts from our conversation:

1/ Affirm has roughly 50% market share in US buy now, pay later

2/ Max Levchin earns less than $40,000 in annual salary and owns billions in Affirm stock. He now spends much of his time working with a small engineering team on new products.

3/ Affirm can have negative customer acquisition costs. 

4/ 70% of purchase volume comes from interest-bearing loans

5/ Affirm earns roughly 4% gross profit on purchase volume after funding costs and credit losses.

6/ Affirm underwrites every transaction individually

7/ Affirm Card already accounts for roughly 20% of purchase volume an

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay：$NBIS獲花旗35億美元融資額度用於GPU及數據中心，利率為SOFR加2.75%；364天結構讓其即時購入GPU，而逾400億美元的$META及$MSFT長約可支持日後更低成本融資。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $NBIS secured a $3.5B Citi financing facility for GPUs and data centers at SOFR + 2.75%; the 364 day structure funds GPUs now while $40B+ of long term $META and $MSFT contracts could support cheaper financing later.
text:
$NBIS just secured a $3.5B financing facility from Citi to fund GPU purchases and AI data center expansion with borrowing costs starting at SOFR + 2.75%.

Whats great is that the 364-day structure gives Nebius capital to secure GPUs now while its $40B+ in long-term $META and $MSFT contracts could support cheaper financing as capacity comes online.
